reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly attributes the enhanced properties of CrCoNi to Mn absence lowering SFE, whereas extensive literature shows CrCoNi already has lower SFE than CrMnFeCoNi and the proposed magnetic frustration mechanism is speculative and not well-supported.
reasons.testability: The proposed in situ TEM tensile test with quantitative measurement of hcp onset strain and work hardening rate provides a clear, feasible, and decisive falsification criterion.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis targets a well-known property difference but relies on a questionable mechanism; testing it would not advance understanding as effectively as hypotheses based on established SFE trends.
